text:
emily (support): Hey team — ACME Inc reports that their dashboard shows a $50 trial grant applied, but their API usage is still being billed. Customer says console shows the grant under Admin > Grants, status=applied, but their project usage lines still show charges. Can someone help triage?

omar (billing): Can you share the service key and project id (or the project slug) so we can look up metering? Also roughly when they started using the key.

emily (support): Service key they gave: sk_live_acme_7b9f. Project slug: acme-web-2026. Issue started yesterday around 15:40 UTC after they upgraded to our JS SDK v2. Console screenshot attached (they sent a screenshot URL).

jenna (devex): Quick question — are they calling via the SDK or direct REST? And are they setting a project header? SDK v2 added some header normalization changes recently. If the request header the SDK sends differs from what the metering pipeline expects, the grant might not be mapped.

emily (support): They're *mostly* using the SDK (node). They say they didn't set any explicit project header, relying on the service key. They tried a manual curl and said that the curl showed the grant applied — but I didn't get the raw request headers.

kai (eng-api): Thanks — this sounds like the mapping edge-case I patched last week. Short version: metering expects a project id extracted either from the service key mapping or from X-Redwood-Project header. SDK v2 started emitting a lowercase header name `x-redwood-project` in some flows; our mapping service did a strict-case check and missed it. Result: requests landed unassociated -> defaulted to `unallocated` project and billed.

kai (eng-api): Repro steps I used locally:
```
# working (explicit header)
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_acme_7b9f" -H "X-Redwood-Project: acme-web-2026" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
# broken (sdk v2 path sending lowercase header)
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_acme_7b9f" -H "x-redwood-project: acme-web-2026" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
# mapping service log shows: "project_id: null, headers: {x-redwood-project: 'acme-web-2026'} -> dropped"
```

kai (eng-api): Root cause: mapping consumer was doing `headers.get('X-Redwood-Project')` instead of case-insensitive lookup. I've prepared a tiny hotfix to canonicalize header names before lookup.

emily (support): I grabbed a sample log from the customer's request (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-16T15:42:12Z] trace=tr_3f8b req_id=req_abc123 service_key=sk_live_acme_7b9f headers={"x-redwood-project":"acme-web-2026","user-agent":"acme-sdk/2.0"} project_lookup_result=null
metering.event => -> project=unallocated cost_usd=0.004 tokens=237
```

omar (billing): If that's the log, we need to refund the billed usage that was attributed to `unallocated` and reassign it to acme-web-2026. Can engineering confirm how many requests were missed?

kai (eng-api): I'm rolling the header-normalization patch to staging now. It will: (1) normalize header keys to lower-case, (2) prefer explicit project header, (3) fall back to the service key mapping. After staging verification I'll push to prod. I can also run a backfill job to re-process metering events where project_lookup_result was null and a matching header existed in the raw request blob.

metering-bot: deployment mapping-service v1.14.3 -> staging (hotfix/header-normalization) — started at 2026-03-16T17:05:00Z

jenna (devex): Workaround for customers: set explicit header `X-Redwood-Project: acme-web-2026` in their requests or use the older SDK until we patch. Emily, can you pass this to ACME? Also tell them we will reconcile billing once backfill completes.

emily (support): Will do. I've given them the header workaround and told them we'll follow up with credits after engineering confirms the backfill. Customer is relieved but wants ETA on refunds.

kai (eng-api): ETA: patch -> prod in ~90 minutes if staging checks look good. Backfill estimate: depends on size, but I'll start a targeted backfill for trace ids between 2026-03-16T15:30 and 2026-03-16T18:00 and report counts. I'll post an update in this thread.

omar (billing): Thanks. Once kai posts the count, I'll open an internal billing ticket and prepare the credit.

emily (support): Thanks all — keeping customer updated. Will follow up here after kai confirms backfill count. :thumbsup:
